constraints.definition: CHECK (((environment <> 'prod'::deployment_environment) OR (status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::deployment_status, 'superseded'::deployment_status, 'rolled_back'::deployment_status])) OR (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (rollback_of_id) REFERENCES deployments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: deployments_rollback_reason_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((rollback_of_id IS NULL) OR (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM rollback_reason)) > 0)))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::deployment_status, 'cancelled'::deployment_status])) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (activated_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'rejected'::deployment_status) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (activated_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::deployment_status, 'superseded'::deployment_status, 'rolled_back'::deployment_status])) AND (activated_at IS NOT NULL))))

views.name: deployment_history
views.definition:
SELECT deployment.id,
    deployment.prompt_id,
    prompt.project_id,
    deployment.version_id,
    version.version_number,
    deployment.environment,
    deployment.status,
    deployment.request_note,
    deployment.review_note,
    deployment.rollback_reason,
    deployment.rollback_of_id,
    deployment.requested_by,
    deployment.reviewed_by,
    deployment.requested_at,
    deployment.reviewed_at,
    deployment.activated_at
   FROM deployments deployment
     JOIN prompts prompt ON prompt.id = deployment.prompt_id
     JOIN prompt_versions version ON version.id = deployment.version_id;

views.name: monthly_costs
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, created_at) AS month,
    user_id,
    project_id,
    provider,
    model,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status) AS completed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'::run_status) AS failed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'blocked'::run_status) AS blocked_runs,
    COALESCE(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status), 0::numeric)::numeric(18,6) AS cost
   FROM runs
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, created_at)), user_id, project_id, provider, model;

views.name: organization_monthly_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, created_at) AS month,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status) AS completed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'::run_status) AS failed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'blocked'::run_status) AS blocked_runs,
    COALESCE(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status), 0::numeric)::numeric(18,6) AS total_cost,
    max(created_at) AS refreshed_through
   FROM runs
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, created_at));

views.name: prompt_version_lineage
views.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE lineage AS (
         SELECT version.id AS descendant_version_id,
            version.id AS version_id,
            version.parent_version_id,
            0 AS depth,
            ARRAY[version.id] AS path,
            false AS cycle_detected
           FROM prompt_versions version
        UNION ALL
         SELECT lineage_1.descendant_version_id,
            parent.id,
            parent.parent_version_id,
            lineage_1.depth + 1,
            lineage_1.path || parent.id,
            parent.id = ANY (lineage_1.path)
           FROM lineage lineage_1
             JOIN prompt_versions parent ON parent.id = lineage_1.parent_version_id
          WHERE NOT lineage_1.cycle_detected AND lineage_1.depth < 1000
        )
 SELECT descendant_version_id,
    version_id,
    parent_version_id,
    depth,
    cycle_detected
   FROM lineage;

views.name: user_monthly_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, created_at) AS month,
    user_id,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status) AS completed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'::run_status) AS failed_runs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'blocked'::run_status) AS blocked_runs,
    COALESCE(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::run_status), 0::numeric)::numeric(18,6) AS total_cost,
    max(created_at) AS refreshed_through
   FROM runs
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, created_at)), user_id;
